name: Mercuryo Nova x Mercuryo Card
summary: A specialized non-custodial debit card designed for the Polkadot ecosystem, allowing Nova Wallet users to spend DOT tokens at any Mastercard merchant.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required
Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Mercuryo Nova x Mercuryo Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Mercuryo Nova x Mercuryo Card?
faq.answer: It charges about 1% on non-base-currency spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the Mercuryo Nova x Mercuryo Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
